name: Speculative + trend (paper)
description: Split core with a thematic tilt and a 200-day trend rule on the SPY part. From research/speculative-outlook.md, tested 2006-2026: 7.8%/yr, Sharpe 0.71, worst drop -26% vs SPY 11.3%/0.65/-55%.
rebalance: quarterly (first trading day of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct), plus whenever the trend or momentum rule flips

core_spy_trend.rule: SPY while SPY close > 200-day SMA at the prior close, else SHY

ex_us_momentum.rule: monthly: best 12-month return among EFA, EEM, EWJ; SHY if the best is negative

put_write.note: S&P 500 covered-call ETF as the option-income proxy (PUTW is not on Alpaca); swap for the cash-secured-put wheel once the paper-trading thread runs options

watch_flags.trigger: a top-5 hyperscaler cuts next-year capex guidance
watch_flags.action: cut core_spy_trend and core_equal_weight by half into SHY; raise gold and long_bonds

watch_flags.trigger: a named private-credit fund SUSPENDS redemptions entirely, or fails to pay out its stated redemption cap (routine 5% pro-rating does not count)
watch_flags.action: panic playbook: core to SHY regardless of trend, keep gold, bonds, put_write
watch_flags.yellow: requests above 25% of a fund in one quarter, or two or more funds capping in the same quarter: note it, raise cash by 5 pts, no other action

watch_flags.trigger: blockade, strike, or rare-earth export cutoff to the US

watch_flags.action: sell long_bonds into SHY; add to energy and gold

watch_flags.trigger: fed funds effective rate rises 0.25 pt or more within 60 days
watch_flags.action: stagflation tilt: homebuilders to 0, split evenly into energy and gold (sizes set by the paper-trading thread, 2026-10-06)

watch_flags.trigger: IWM beats SPY over each of the last two calendar quarters
watch_flags.action: move 10 pts from core_spy_trend to core_equal_weight
deploy cash into SPY; unwind when VIX closes below 20
